a.lede: Apple has just released iOS 27.2, bringing Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo. The software update also includes an "Edge Light" feature for the iPhone Duo that's intended to illuminate your face during video calls. a.title: iPhone Duo now supports Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2

b.lede: On this day in 2001, Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the original iPod. He began the presentation by teasing 'a breakthrough digital device that’s not a Mac.'
b.title: The original Apple iPod debuted 25 years ago today
